SELECT mbptr.id AS produce_team_report_id, mbptr.task_type_enum AS product_type_enum, mbptr.report_time, mbptr.inspection_quantity, mbpl.workshop_id AS 'workshop.id', mbw.name AS 'workshop.name', cp.id AS 'project.id', cp.short_name AS 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number AS 'project.serial_number', pm.id AS 'monomer.id', pm.name AS 'monomer.name', mbptr.team_id AS 'team.id', mbtul.user_name AS 'team.name', mbptr.process_id AS 'process.id', mbp.name AS 'process.name', mbp.type AS process_type, mbptr.product_id AS 'product.id', product.serial_number AS 'product.serial_number', product.specification AS 'product.specification', product.material AS 'product.material',
pc.id AS 'product.class_id', pc.classification_name AS 'product.class_name', mbpitr.report_time AS inspection_date, mbpitr.user_id AS 'inspector.id', inspector.name AS 'inspector.name',
pc.id AS 'product.class_id', pc.name AS 'product.class_name', mbpitr.report_time AS inspection_date, mbpitr.user_id AS 'inspector.id', inspector.name AS 'inspector.name',
pc.id AS 'product.class_id', pc.name AS 'product.class_name', product.product_classification_enum AS 'product.product_classification_enum', product.thick AS 'product.thick',
product.net_weight AS 'product.net_weight', product.surface_area AS 'product.surface_area', product.length AS 'product.length', product.monomer_id AS 'product.monomer_id', mbt.task_order_id, mbto.order_number AS task_order_number, if(mbto.child_guid IS NOT NULL , true, false) AS nest_task FROM mes_building_produce_team_report mbptr LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line mbpl ON mbpl.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbpl.id = mbptr.production_line_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop mbw ON mbw.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbw.id = mbpl.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_task mbt ON mbt.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbt.id = mbptr.task_id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cp.id = mbt.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND pm.id = mbt.monomer_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link mbtul ON mbtul.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbtul.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND mbtul.team_id = mbptr.team_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON mbp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbp.id = mbptr.process_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_order mbto ON mbto.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbto.id = mbt.task_order_id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbptr.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND product.id = mbptr.product_id LEFT JOIN sys_structure_classification pc ON pc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND pc.id = product.structure_class_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report mbpitr ON mbpitr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbpitr.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND mbpitr.product_id = mbptr.product_id AND mbpitr.number = mbptr.number AND mbpitr.process_id = mbptr.process_id LEFT JOIN sys_user inspector ON inspector.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND inspector.id = mbpitr.user_id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbptr.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ASSEMBLE.getType()} AND product.id = mbptr.product_id LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config pc ON pc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND pc.id = product.assemble_config_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report mbpitr ON mbpitr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbpitr.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ASSEMBLE.getType()} AND mbpitr.product_id = mbptr.product_id AND mbpitr.number = mbptr.number AND mbpitr.process_id = mbptr.process_id LEFT JOIN sys_user inspector ON inspector.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND inspector.id = mbpitr.user_id
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbptr.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@MACHINE_PART.getType()} AND product.id = mbptr.product_id LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classification pc ON pc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND pc.id = product.steel_id
WHERE mbptr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbptr.bool_wage_elimination = 0 AND mbptr.inspection_quantity > 0 AND mbptr.task_type_enum = #{productTypeEnum} AND mbptr.id NOT IN (select produce_team_report_id FROM mes_report_work_approved WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0)
AND mbpl.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND mbt.project_id = #{projectId}
AND mbptr.process_id = #{processId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(mbptr.report_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(mbptr.report_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND year(mbptr.report_time) = #{year}
AND product.serial_number LIKE concat('%', #{productSerialNumber}, '%')

SELECT count(0) FROM mes_building_produce_team_report mbptr WHERE mbptr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbptr.bool_wage_elimination = 0 AND mbptr.inspection_quantity > 0 AND mbptr.id NOT IN (select produce_team_report_id FROM mes_report_work_approved WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0) AND year(mbptr.report_time) = #{year}

SELECT SUM(t.weight) FROM ( SELECT IFNULL(mbptr.inspection_quantity * (product.net_weight / 1000), 0) AS weight FROM mes_building_produce_team_report mbptr LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND product.id = mbptr.product_id WHERE mbptr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbptr.bool_wage_elimination = 0 AND mbptr.inspection_quantity > 0 AND mbptr.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND YEAR(mbptr.report_time) = #{year} UNION SELECT IFNULL(mbptr.inspection_quantity * (product.net_weight / 1000), 0) AS weight FROM mes_building_produce_team_report mbptr LEFT JOIN tech_assemble product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND product.id = mbptr.product_id WHERE mbptr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbptr.inspection_quantity > 0 AND mbptr.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ASSEMBLE.getType()} AND YEAR(mbptr.report_time) = #{year} UNION SELECT IFNULL(mbptr.inspection_quantity * (product.net_weight / 1000), 0) AS weight FROM mes_building_produce_team_report mbptr LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND product.id = mbptr.product_id WHERE mbptr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbptr.inspection_quantity > 0 AND mbptr.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@MACHINE_PART.getType()} AND YEAR(mbptr.report_time) = #{year} ) t
SELECT sum(mrwa.total_weight / 1000) FROM mes_report_work_approved mrwa WHERE mrwa.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND year(mrwa.approval_time) = #{year}

SELECT mbw.id AS 'workshop.id', mbw.name AS 'workshop.name', mbp.product_type AS product_type_enum, mbp.id AS 'process.id', mbp.name AS 'process.name', mbtul.team_id AS 'team.id', mbtul.user_name AS 'team.name', '吨' AS unit, t.production_quantity, t.wage, t.start_time, t.end_time FROM ( SELECT st.workshop_id, st.process_id, st.team_id, IFNULL(SUM(st.total_weight / 1000), 0) AS production_quantity, IFNULL(SUM(st.total_price), 0) AS wage, min(st.approval_time) AS start_time, max(st.approval_time) AS end_time FROM ( select mrwa.workshop_id, mrwa.process_id, mrwa.team_id, mrwa.total_weight, mrwa.total_price, mrwa.approval_time from mes_report_work_approved mrwa where mrwa.bool_delete_enum = 0 UNION ALL SELECT mbt.workshop_id, mbt.process_id, mtw.team_id, NULL, calculate_amount, mtw.approval_time from mes_temp_work mtw Left JOIN mes_building_team mbt ON mbt.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbt.id = mtw.team_id WHERE mtw.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mtw.approval_status = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ReviewStatusEnum@REVIEWED.getType()} ) st
AND st.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND st.process_id = #{processId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(st.approval_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(st.approval_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
GROUP BY st.workshop_id, st.process_id, st.team_id ) t LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop mbw ON mbw.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbw.id = t.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON mbp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbp.id = t.process_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link mbtul ON mbtul.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbtul.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND mbtul.team_id = t.team_id
AND mbtul.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{teamName}, '%')

select min(t.id) AS id, t.name, t.`project.id`, t.`project.shortName`, t.`project.serialNumber`, t.`product.serialNumber`, t.`product.specification`, sum(t.accounting_quantity) AS accounting_quantity, t.define_type, t.price, sum(t.total_price) AS total_price, t.production_date, t.approval_time, t.`approvalUser.id`, t.`approvalUser.name` FROM ( select mrwa.id, NULL AS name, cp.id AS 'project.id', cp.short_name AS 'project.shortName', cp.serial_number AS 'project.serialNumber', product.id AS 'product.id', product.serial_number AS 'product.serialNumber', product.specification AS 'product.specification', mrwa.accounting_quantity, mrwa.define_type, mrwa.price, mrwa.total_price, mrwa.report_time AS production_date, mrwa.approval_time, mrwa.approval_user_id AS 'approvalUser.id', au.name AS 'approvalUser.name' from mes_report_work_approved mrwa LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cp.id = mrwa.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au on au.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND au.id = mrwa.approval_user_id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mrwa.product_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND product.id = mrwa.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mrwa.product_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ASSEMBLE.getType()} AND product.id = mrwa.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mrwa.product_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@MACHINE_PART.getType()} AND product.id = mrwa.product_id
WHERE mrwa.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mrwa.product_type_enum = #{productTypeEnum} and mrwa.workshop_id = #{workshopId} and mrwa.process_id = #{processId} and mrwa.team_id = #{teamId} UNION ALL select mtw.id, '点工' AS name, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, mtw.calculate_amount AS total_price, mtw.report_date AS production_date, mtw.approval_time, mtw.approval_user_id AS 'approvalUser.id', au.name AS 'approvalUser.name' FROM mes_temp_work mtw LEFT JOIN sys_user au on au.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND au.id = mtw.approval_user_id WHERE mtw.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mtw.approval_status = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ReviewStatusEnum@REVIEWED.getType()} AND mtw.team_id = #{teamId} ) t WHERE date_format(t.approval_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{startDate} and date_format(t.approval_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{endDate} GROUP BY t.name, t.`project.id`, t.`project.shortName`, t.`project.serialNumber`, t.`product.serialNumber`, t.`product.specification`, t.define_type, t.price, t.production_date, t.approval_time, t.`approvalUser.id`, t.`approvalUser.name`
